# WabaPanel

> WabaPanel by KKHS Media is a complete WhatsApp Business API CRM & AI automation platform. It combines a shared team inbox (WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram), an AI chatbot trainable on PDFs/Excel/websites, a drag-and-drop bot flow builder, broadcast & drip campaigns, keyword auto-replies, a Kanban sales pipeline CRM, AI voice calling, WhatsApp catalog/store, payment links and white-label reselling.

## Key facts
- Product: WhatsApp Business API SaaS panel (web application)
- Company: KKHS Media (https://kkhsmedia.com)
- Website: https://wabapanel.com
- Pricing: Free ₹0 · Starter ₹999/mo · Growth ₹1,499/mo · Business ₹1,999/mo (yearly -20%)
- Supports: official WhatsApp Cloud API and QR-based WhatsApp connections
- AI: chatbot trained on your own data, AI follow-ups, AI voice calling assistant
- Also sold as a self-hosted NodeJS product with full source code and lifetime license

## FAQ
- What is WabaPanel? A WhatsApp Business API CRM and AI automation platform for sales, support and marketing on WhatsApp.
- Is there a free plan? Yes, ₹0 forever plan; paid plans from ₹999/month.
- Can the AI be trained on my data? Yes — PDFs, Excel files and website content.
- Does it support broadcasts and templates? Yes — template messages, broadcasts, drip campaigns and click-to-WhatsApp ads.
